contract.placeholderAssets: The cue buffers are procedural placeholders generated by a deterministic synthesiser; they are not the final recorded assets of module 16.

scenarios.name: gesture-start
scenarios.detail: Before the gesture the engine is IDLE and refuses the cues; the gesture creates the context.

scenarios.name: mute-isolation
scenarios.detail: Mute sets the master gain to zero; the events, the ticks and the voice work continue.

scenarios.name: impact-028
scenarios.detail: A COLLISION event of the 028 adapter becomes an impact cue on the impact bus.

scenarios.name: voice-cap
scenarios.detail: The category cap bounds the pool; a louder vehicle steals a quieter slot.

scenarios.name: inaudible-vs-audible
scenarios.detail: Thirty vehicles out of reach allocate no voice; one close vehicle allocates exactly one.

scenarios.name: disposal
scenarios.detail: The disposal releases every voice, the ownership and the audio context, once.

checks.name: gesture/state-before
checks.detail: The engine waits for the gesture.

checks.name: gesture/contexts-before
checks.detail: No audio context exists before the gesture.

checks.name: gesture/impact-refused
checks.detail: A collision before the gesture is refused, not played in the background.

checks.name: gesture/contexts-after
checks.detail: The gesture creates exactly one audio context.

checks.name: gesture/cue-after
checks.detail: The first vehicle allocates its engine voice after the gesture.

checks.name: mute/effective-gain-zero
checks.detail: Mute zeroes the output gain.

checks.name: mute/category-gain-untouched
checks.detail: Mute does not rewrite the mixer levels.

checks.name: mute/events-still-delivered
checks.detail: The simulation events keep flowing while the audio is muted.

checks.name: mute/impact-still-processed
checks.detail: The muted engine still processes the impacts.

checks.name: mute/voices-still-active
checks.detail: The voices are kept alive; only the output gain is zero.

checks.name: impact/handled
checks.detail: The bridge consumed the collision event.

checks.name: impact/voices
checks.detail: The impact bus owns the cue.

checks.name: impact/engine-bus-untouched
checks.detail: The engine bus is not used.

checks.name: impact/cue
checks.detail: The impact cue was played.

checks.name: cap/active-voices
checks.detail: The pool respects the category cap.

checks.name: cap/stolen
checks.detail: The louder vehicle stole the quieter slot.

checks.name: cap/dropped
checks.detail: The quietest cue was dropped instead.

checks.name: cap/owners
checks.detail: The stolen voice released its ownership.

checks.name: inaudible/no-voice
checks.detail: The out of reach fleet starts no voice.

checks.name: inaudible/one-voice
checks.detail: The close vehicle starts exactly one voice.

checks.name: inaudible/buffer-lazy
checks.detail: No audio buffer is created for an inaudible fleet.

checks.name: inaudible/buffer-cap
checks.detail: The owned buffer bytes stay under the explicit cap.

checks.name: disposal/released
checks.detail: The ownership release frees one voice.

checks.name: disposal/state
checks.detail: The engine is closed.

checks.name: disposal/voices
checks.detail: No voice survives the disposal.

checks.name: disposal/context
checks.detail: The audio context is closed.
